descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S19 Wrong device clock in the browser (3.8), two browser contexts on one account: same badge, same pre-selected template, server day stored

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 The day roll uses server time, not the device clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock set or another time zone shows the same badge and the same pre-selected template as any other device, and nev … (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8)
  • U5 New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day without the physician touching them; a status set today stays today (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given One fresh account open in two Playwright browser contexts: A with the correct clock; B with page.clock at server day + 1, then server day - 1, then timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu (UTC-10); one Hospital patient and one resident, untouched

When c1: B (day - 1) sets the Hospital patient and the resident to New Admission; A opens both charts. c2: A sets them to New Admission; B (day + 1) opens both lists and charts; A reloads. c3: B (day + 1) sets both to Consult; the runner reads rounding:list / snf:list. c4: c1 and c2 again with B on Pacific/Honolulu

Then In every cell A and B show the same badge and the same Note Format [selected] option (New Admission -> H&P / SNF admission; Consult -> Consult note); B opening the app never rolls A's status; the stored encTypeDay is the server day, never B's day (a row stamped server day + 1 would read New Admission for two days, S10)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8 'shows the same state as any other device' + TFA-92584 AC 8. Each check is a mustContain on A's or B's snapshot (badge and Note Format [selected]) or on the stored encTypeDay, with knownGap 'TFA-92584 AC 8': main e02167f takes the day from the device (localDay() in AppLayout.tsx:119, useNoteFormats.ts, useBillingSuggestion.ts:112-116), so the expected verdict on main i …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (two contexts, page.clock +/-1 day, timezoneId)); secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
